entities.name: Thelon
entities.description: Elven druid from Sarpadia who created the thallids to feed his people.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: Thelon's native elven home on Sarpadia.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungus creatures cultivated by Thelon that raised saprolings for food and later turned sentient and aggressive.

entities.name: Saprolings
entities.description: Creatures generated by thallids as food.

entities.name: Thelonites
entities.description: Order of elves, humans and sentient insects, druids and monks who used blood sacrifices.

entities.name: Morgan
entities.description: Thelonite druid who saw thallids as mere fodder and ambushed Loren.

entities.name: Loren
entities.description: Thelon's son, a master scout killed in an ambush by Morgan.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event whose climate changes made food scarce.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order whose method of creating thrulls Thelon's resembled.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event that returned Thelon's reflection to his original timeline.

events.summary: After the Sylex Blast, Thelon cultivates fungus with green mana into thallids to raise saprolings for food.
events.quote: Calling them thallids , they were raised like cattle to produce saprolings for food.

events.summary: The thallids save Havenwood's elves from starvation and lead to the Thelonite order.
events.quote: This saved the elves of his native Havenwood from starvation

events.summary: The thallids grow sentient and aggressive, causing an elven rift led by Morgan and Loren.
events.quote: Thelon's miracle was short-lived, as over time the thallids grew sentient and aggressive.

events.summary: Morgan ambushes and kills Loren, widening the rift, and the thallids overrun Havenwood in almost a day.
events.quote: allowing for the thallids to overrun all of Havenwood in almost a single day.

relations.quote: Thelon's own son, the master scout Loren
would eventually ambush and kill Loren.
